0022600003.text: Both the San Antonio Spurs and Oklahoma City Thunder are opening their 2026-27 seasons, with the Spurs hosting at home. In 2025-26, the Spurs won the regular-season series 4-1 and took the playoff series 4-3, with their most recent meeting a 111-103 playoff win in Oklahoma City on May 30. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), Oklahoma City is without Nikola Topic (back, surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles, surgery) and Thomas Sorber (knee, surgery), and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Spurs a 55% chance to win.
